items.title: Code of Conduct, Conflict of Interest, Integrity Commissioner (9:00am)
notes: John Mascarin, Aird & Berlis provided an overview of Council’s responsibility with respect to the Code of Conflict and the Conflict of Interest Act and outlined the role of the Integrity Commissioner.

items.title: Ministry of Municipal Affairs (10:30am)
notes: Jennifer Kostyria, Municipal Advisor provided information with respect to Municipal government and organization, changes to Council composition, Council as lawmakers, exercising municipal powers and fiscal context.

items.title: Financial
notes: Dan Wilson, CAO and Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer, Centre Wellington provided an overview of asset management and development charges.
Shauna Calder, Manager of Finance, County of Wellington outlined property tax policies.
A recess was called for lunch at 12:30pm and the meeting resumed at 1:30pm.

items.title: Fire Training
notes: Officer Charles Hamilton, Wellington County Training Officer provided an overview of the ongoing fire training program.

items.title: Social Services
notes: Luisa Artuso, Social Services Administrator, County of Wellington provided an overview of the three divisions of social services; Children’s Early Years, Housing Services and Ontario Works.

items.title: Solid Waste Services
notes: Don Kudo, County Engineer, County of Wellington provided an overview of Solid Waste Services, including major functions, current activities, emerging issues and challenges.

items.title: County Planning Overview
notes: Sarah Wilhelm, Manager of Policy Planning, County of Wellington provided an overview of the responsibilities of the planning department, including emerging issues related to Bill 23.
Karen Chisholme, Climate Change and Sustainability Manager, County of Wellington provided an overview of ongoing initiatives targeted to reduce community greenhouse gases.
Paul Barson, GIS Analyst, County of Wellington outlined the major GIS mapping programs and tools available, including Explore Wellington, highlighting the various core layers and major themes.

Kyle Davis, Risk Management Official provided an overview of the Wellington Source Water Protection, including the origin of source water projection, the Clean Water Act, and municipal well head protection areas.
Bobby De Hetre, Emergency Manager, CEMC provided an overview of the County’s Emergency Management program.
Donna Bryce thanked the presenters and participants and adjourned the meeting.
